title: A pullback stable at later stages is preserved in the category colimit
statement: Let $J$ be a small filtered category, $F:J\to\mathrm{Cat}$ a diagram of small categories, and $V$ a cocone of $F$. Its object and arrow set cocones [def-weil-pbc-arrows-functor] are colimits [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $j\in J$ and arrows $f:Y\to X$ and $g:Z\to X$ in $F(j)$ whose pullback exists. Suppose every transition functor $F(a)$ for $a:j\to k$ preserves this pullback. Then the cocone functor $V_j:F(j)\to V.pt$ preserves this pullback.

source.place: Tag 09YL (lemma-colimit-sites), pullback paragraph and displayed Hom calculation; consulted at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/09YL

proof.text: Map a chosen limiting pullback cone at j to the cocone category. Given a cone over the image cospan, represent its vertex and legs using joint surjectivity of the object and arrow colimits. Move their representatives and j to a common stage using filteredness. Apply eventual equality in the object colimit to align all endpoints, then eventual equality in the arrow colimit to enforce the cone equation. These are finitely many refinements, so their successive composite suffices.
The transition out of j preserves the original pullback. Its universal property at that stage supplies a mediating arrow; the cocone equations show that its image has the required factorizations.

For two candidate mediating arrows, joint surjectivity lifts them to stages and filteredness moves them above j. Eventual equality aligns their endpoints and enforces both factorization equations. The preserved pullback at that stage identifies the arrows. Their cocone images therefore agree.

Thus the image of the chosen limiting pullback cone is limiting. Any limiting cone of the cospan is uniquely isomorphic to the chosen cone; mapping this isomorphism proves preservation of the cospan limit.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09YL; specialize the Hom calculation to one fixed cospan, expressed through the limiting cone universal property

lean.statement:
theorem filteredColimit_preservesPullback
    (J : Type u) [SmallCategory J] [IsFiltered J] (F : J ⥤ Cat.{u, u})
    (V : Cocone F)
    (hobjects : IsColimit (Cat.objects.mapCocone V))
    (harrows : IsColimit (Cat.arrows.mapCocone V))
    (j : J) {X Y Z : F.obj j} (f : Y ⟶ X) (g : Z ⟶ X) [HasPullback f g]
    (hpres : ∀ (k : J) (a : j ⟶ k),
      PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (F.map a).toFunctor) :
    PreservesLimit (cospan f g) (V.ι.app j).toFunctor
